name: Own actions and past play (I in a clause: when I / I was / I had)
note: mostly the speaker's own shots and choices; some plans and feelings mixed in

name: My / myself / me: my career, my family, my role
note: possessive and object uses; some "my teammates" (others via my)

name: Short personal replies: my body, my routine, I'll
note: injuries, routine, plans; some "I don't know" mixed in

name: I think + a statement about the team or game
note: opinion marker; the content is mostly about the team (I think we...)

name: Sentence-start fillers: I mean, I guess, I don't know
Like I said / as I said
Our best, what we can do (team standards)
What we did in the game (past narration)
What we have to do (plans, obligations)
Results and record (we won, we lost, our first...)
Relationships, pairs, personal we (us two, our first child)
note: mixed: holds 5 of the 10 non-team uses in the Step 12 check

name: Members of the group (our team, our guys, our trainers)
We know, we feel, we believe (shared view)
